extension.summary: openHAB in Kodi: floors, rooms, devices, floor plans and a house status widget
openHAB v Kodi: poschodia, izby, zariadenia, pôdorysy a widget so stavom domu
extension.description: Browse and control an openHAB server from Kodi in any skin: floors, rooms and devices from openHAB's semantic model, floor plans with room temperatures (orange = heating, red = problem), a House status list usable as a widget (problems first), switches, temperature and option dialogs. Floor plans, status items, labels and problem conditions come from item metadata (namespace "kodi") in your openHAB, nothing house-specific is in the add-on.[CR][CR]Setup: an openHAB user with role "user" and its API token (openHAB console: openhab:users add kodi PASSWORD user, openhab:users addApiToken kodi kodi admin - token name letters/digits only), then the openHAB address and token in the add-on settings.[CR][CR]Main menu: Aeon Nox 5 - "Add to the main menu (Aeon Nox 5)" in the add-on (first free Custom1-6 slot, its background = house status picture). Skins with a home menu editor (Skin Shortcuts, e.g. Arctic Horizon 2): customize home menu - add item - Add-on - openHAB Home. Estuary: Add-ons - Program add-ons.[CR][CR]Full guide incl. the metadata format: https://github.com/xDereCx/kodi-x96max-fixes/tree/master/plugin.program.xderecx.openhab

Prehliadanie a ovládanie servera openHAB z Kodi v ľubovoľnom skine: poschodia, izby a zariadenia zo sémantického modelu openHABu, pôdorysy s teplotami izieb (oranžová = kúri, červená = problém), zoznam Stav domu použiteľný aj ako widget (najprv problémy), vypínače, výber teploty a možností. Pôdorysy, položky stavu, názvy a podmienky problémov sú v metadátach items (menný priestor "kodi") v tvojom openHABe, v doplnku nie je nič o konkrétnom dome.[CR][CR]Nastavenie: používateľ openHAB s rolou "user" a jeho API token (konzola openHAB: openhab:users add kodi HESLO user, openhab:users addApiToken kodi kodi admin - názov tokenu len písmená a číslice), potom adresa openHAB a token v nastaveniach doplnku.[CR][CR]Hlavné menu: Aeon Nox 5 - "Pridať do hlavného menu (Aeon Nox 5)" v doplnku (prvý voľný slot Custom1-6, jeho pozadie = obrázok stavu domu). Skiny s editorom menu (Skin Shortcuts, napr. Arctic Horizon 2): úprava hlavného menu - pridať položku - Doplnok - openHAB Home. Estuary: Doplnky - Programové doplnky.[CR][CR]Celý návod vrátane formátu metadát: https://github.com/xDereCx/kodi-x96max-fixes/tree/master/plugin.program.xderecx.openhab
extension.news: 2.6.6: left panel: big value in its own column with items under it (side, under), forecast table with two columns and a weather icon per column (split, split_icons, header), strip of hours with weather icons (hours), icon_size; templates: {A?B} fallback, ~small~ units, dates with the year; justify=left per row; plan rectangles rounded at their edges (no 1 px steps between rooms). 2.6.5: house status picture: all floors in scale share one scale (the house is equally large on every floor); status item groups in their own rectangle (area, also on a floor without a room via floor), rows per column, size mini / micro, justify=left in right corners, noicon, table rows (cols "left|centre|right", header), text templates for status items with {Item|n} number, {Item|i} whole number, {Item|d} date; colors with numeric conditions (e.g. red below 0, green above 0); icons in any size scaled from the 56 px ones. 2.6.4: the background service notices an add-on update while it keeps running (Kodi does not always restart it) and reloads its drawing code, so the picture no longer stays on the old version until Kodi restarts. 2.6.3: with a left panel the problems line starts under the plans, so the panel gets the full height; icon colours from metadata: icon_colors (state -> colour, e.g. ON=orange,OFF=blue) and icon_range (number low,high -> blue over white to red, e.g. a water tank 18,90). 2.6.2: left panel in 2 columns (panel_columns), full-width rows (wide), sub-headings (section), values from templates of several items (text="{A} / {B}"), colour weather icons from Kodi's icon pack (weather_icon = weather.com code); numbers from 100 up without decimals; fonts with ² ³. 2.6.1: house status picture without the title (the skin shows the menu name and its top bar covers it), plans start higher; panel=left: status items in a column left of the plans (big, panel_title), the plans move right; weather icons (wind, compass, rain, pressure, uv, sun). 2.6.0: house status picture: every valve's temperature with its setpoint in small type below it, own position per valve (metadata at / part / small on the temperature point, several valves per room), flame next to its number (no overlap in small rooms); status items in any corner of a room (align top-left / top-right / bottom-left / bottom-right), further columns and smaller type when they do not fit, small=true; state texts and colours from metadata (map, colors, e.g. OL=GRID / OB=BATT); new smaller font and icon sizes. 2.5.0: house status picture: status items drawn in their rooms on the plans (metadata room, part, align, compact; items without a room in a strip), picture area setting (whole screen / top 3/4 / left 3/4, default top 3/4), floor metadata stretch=true draws a sketched floor as large as the measured one, temperature font fitted to the room, state option labels from openHAB; the log says why no picture is drawn. 2.4.0: "Add to the main menu (Aeon Nox 5)" no longer adds the House status widget (the house status is the background picture); widget type settings removed; "Remove from the main menu" also clears the background; house status picture: a third row in the status strip when ten items do not fit (the plans get lower) instead of dropping items. 2.3.0: house status picture redesigned, 1920x1080: the floor plans (no room names) with each room's temperature in red (below its setpoint) or green, a flame when heat is needed or the valve heats, problems below, the status items in a strip at the bottom. 2.2.0: house status picture as the background of the add-on's Aeon Nox 5 main menu item - a background service draws it every 5 minutes (setting) in pure Python (problems, rooms with temperature and flame when heating, items marked status with their icon) and sets it as the item's background; bundled DejaVu font atlases; status items can have an icon (metadata config icon=flame|water|fridge|freezer|person|ups|…). 2.1.0: floor plan icons (Material Icons, Apache 2.0): thermometer with "now → target" (shortened for narrow rooms), flame when heating, warning on problems, icon legend; rectangles of one room are joined across the wall gap so L-shaped rooms and niches look like one room. 2.0.1: floor plan rooms can have up to 8 extra rectangles (x2…x9, for L shapes and niches). 2.0.0: general add-on - floor plans, house status items, labels and problem conditions now come from openHAB item metadata (namespace "kodi") instead of the code; English + Slovak via language files; room temperature from points marked temperature/setpoint/mode/heating; problems from metadata conditions; full setup guide in the add-on's README. Settings and the Aeon Nox 5 menu entry stay as they are.
